units.en: Restore Byzantium and have Italy, Romania, and Russia as subjects.
Can be done as any flavor of Byzantium ("Byzantine Empire", "East-Roman Democratic Republic", "Byzantine Commune", etc.)

It's okay to only get part of each country, but it may not fire unless the original is ⟦0⟧ gone. E.g., if you do it as part of the Allies, a plausible outcome is that you'll have Repubblica Sociale Italiana as a puppet and Hellenic Mandate of Russia as a supervised state, and there will be independent countries Italian Union (created when British Italy is released) and Russian Federation. That counts.

Change government to fascism as quickly as possible (using ⟦0⟧ focus if ⟦1⟧ is active). Justify on ⟦2⟧ and ⟦3⟧, timing it so the justifications complete right after the Anschluss (February 1938). Join the Axis, which will consist of ⟦4⟧ alone. Declare both wars simultaneously, drawing ⟦5⟧ and ⟦6⟧ into a war with Germany. Get as much war participation as possible and puppet both in the peace conference. You can then proceed to defeat ⟦7⟧ and the ⟦8⟧ alongside the Axis.

Puppetting your targets is not difficult, as Germany prefers to take land for itself. The only one to watch for is Romania: if the Turkish Straits are closed, Germany will have no land or sea route to Romania and might puppet instead.

Go down the left side focus and choose to work with the fascists. Once ⟦0⟧ focus is reached, start it and choose to invite ⟦1⟧ along to prevent the loss of stability. Do not follow up to ⟦2⟧ yet, pick any other focus for now and soon you will get the Anatolian Fascist coup. As soon as you turn fascist, justify on ⟦3⟧ immediately. Don't forget the planes you start with - even a small amount of Air Superiority and CAS damage goes a long way. Puppet Bulgaria and follow up with ⟦4⟧ to start the war with ⟦5⟧ and ⟦6⟧.

Timing is critical here: on historical, Romania may drop the guarantee in January 1939, and Turkey often/always gets guaranteed by the UK and/or France by March 1939, you want to go to war with Turkey before that happens.

Do not call Bulgaria to war yet, focus on defeating Turkey first. If you can get Naval Supremacy, naval invasions are great here, as you can just walk around the enemy to each of the VPs. Once you defeat Turkey and restore Byzantium, you can start working on Romania, dig in on the Bulgarian border and let the Romanian troops destroy themselves in the offensive, then start pushing in. You can start justifying on ⟦0⟧ now if you wish. Alternatively you can prepare some transport planes earlier and convert your mountaineers to paratroopers, once you have captured Bucharest you can send the paratroopers to snatch some victory points in the north and west to instantly capitulate Romania. Puppet or annex Romania. If you justified on Hungary, they should be an easier opponent than Romania and Turkey unless you are too late and they already joined the Axis.

Note that Romania can sometimes decide to join the Axis in late 1939 based on your war, but this seems quite random. If you face this issue, you can push Turkey out of Istanbul, then guard the city with a small handful of troops, while you send the rest of your forces to crush Romania with your puppet's help. If doing this, you should be able to finish Romania before they have a chance to join the Axis, especially if you start the war in 1938.

Sooner or later ⟦0⟧ will declare on you (often around mid-1940 but there is a decent bit of variance here as well), do not call your puppets to war. If you didn't join the Allies you can start your own faction with ⟦1⟧. Kick the Italians out of ⟦2⟧ and if you get an opening, try launching a naval invasion at Italy and capitulate them to get more war score. You should be able to puppet Italy in the peace deal. You can then prepare the war with the ⟦3⟧. If you somehow managed to keep your democratic popularity above 60% such as by hiring the Social Democrat advisor at the start or taking ⟦4⟧ focus beforehand, you can return to democratic at any time after this. This way you can guarantee ⟦5⟧, ⟦6⟧, and ⟦7⟧ and you can join in the fight and invite them to your faction once the USSR declare war on them. Otherwise, you can justify on USSR after you are done with the Axis, but it is best to wait until they declare war on Iran so they cannot focus their entire forces on you.
